learning_design.input: A supervised actual harmless interval requires different paper and approved local digital form cases, complete independent expected entries, current permitted assistance/correction rules and realistic assigned completion windows with actual start/finish/deadline evidence supplied through an accessible clock/timer or instructor record. The instructor teaches the exact current window/status checks; no unaided clock reading or invented universal speed standard is assumed. Actual task timing is separate from the unobserved planning estimates in this proposal; source-missing work must remain held rather than guessed to meet time.
learning_design.task: Fill every required different actual form using the taught writing/input method, verify complete source accuracy and paper reader-recovered legibility or actual reopened digital entries, preserve attestation/correction boundaries and check real completion against the assigned window. Record true actual finish, support, held/late/failed work and permitted revised arrangements without inventing successful timely performance. Record owner-approved digital or helper-written completion as supported form work, separately from evidence of the learner's own handwriting. This positive handwriting-practice route does not make unaided writing a universal workplace or learner requirement; preserve approved alternatives and their actual support explicitly. Completed drafts do not imply submission or approval.
